cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.0)

# Tomorrow HMI at the HMI type scale, generated by tools/build_fonts.py.
file(GLOB FURNACE_HMI_FONT_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/generated/*.c")
add_library(furnace_hmi_fonts STATIC ${FURNACE_HMI_FONT_SOURCES})
add_library(furnace_hmi::fonts ALIAS furnace_hmi_fonts)

target_include_directories(furnace_hmi_fonts
  PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/include
)
target_link_libraries(furnace_hmi_fonts PUBLIC lvgl::lvgl)
target_compile_features(furnace_hmi_fonts PUBLIC c_std_17)
# Upstream lv_font_conv output: data tables only, compiled without project
# warning policy.
